title: COUNTROWS of an empty table is BLANK, not 0
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( T, FALSE ) ) )

source.quote: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( Table, False ) ) Blank value
source.supports: the article's example, on a table named Table

source.quote: When the table argument contains no rows, the function returns BLANK

derivation: FILTER ( T, FALSE ) keeps none of T's three rows, so COUNTROWS has an empty table and returns BLANK.
